Casa De Monte

Villa in Ko Kaeo
HomeNew ProjectsCasa De Monte

Project overview

Villa community in Ko Kaeo with a greenery theme and classic European elegance. Facilities include a clubhouse and children's play park, with a gated entrance.

Five house types are offered: Aurellia (A2), Sylvia (S), Silvora (S2), Montara (M) and Lavera (L). Aurellia has a land plot of about 280-584 sqm.

Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Casa De Monte?

Casa De Monte is a villas project in Ko Kaeo, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).

What is the starting price of Casa De Monte?

Agent advertised price is ฿30,563,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Casa De Monte?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Casa De Monte be ready?

Current status: pre-sale. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
